title: Query KubeDNS Logs
description: Query Cloud Logging for kube-system KubeDNS and NodeLocalDNS container logs to check for i/o timeouts and resolution failures.
instruction: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="kube-system" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="${cluster_name}" AND (resource.labels.container_name="kubedns" OR resource.labels.container_name="node-cache")' --project ${project_id} --limit 50 --freshness=${freshness}

freshness.description: gcloud log-read window. gcloud defaults to 1 day and returns an empty set with exit 0 for anything older, which reads as a real negative. Widen this to reach a historical incident.
